businesses.business: Florida Panhandle real estate development, hospitality and commercial leasing

offering_description.value: Develops and sells residential homesites and communities on its large landholdings in Northwest Florida. It also owns and operates hotels, clubs, golf courses and marinas, and leases multifamily, retail, office and self-storage properties. Customers include homebuilders, homebuyers, resort guests, members and commercial tenants.

primary_products.value: residential homesites and developed land; homes in master-planned communities; commercial land parcels; some timber

primary_services.value: hotel and resort operations; membership clubs and golf; property leasing and management; marina operations; real estate brokerage

customer_segment.value: B2B: homebuilders, commercial developers, retail and office tenants, multifamily renters, land buyers; B2C: homebuyers, vacationers, club members, golfers, apartment renters

end_markets.value: residential real estate; hospitality and leisure; commercial real estate; retail

revenue_model.value: product sales: homesites, land parcels and some timber sold to builders and buyers; rental or leasing: rents from multifamily, retail, office and self-storage properties; service fees: hotel rooms, food and beverage, club memberships, golf and marina fees
revenue_model.category: product sales; rental or leasing; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs hotels, clubs, golf courses, marinas and leased commercial and residential properties for guests and tenants; other: land developer: entitles and improves owned land, sells homesites to builders and buyers

geography_served.value: US regional: Northwest Florida Panhandle, mainly Bay, Walton, Gulf and Franklin counties, and Northwest Florida generally

specialization.value: related lines: residential development, hospitality and clubs, commercial leasing, all tied to Panhandle land holdings

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: homesite and land sales to homebuilders and developers, plus direct leasing to tenants; own locations: company-owned hotels, clubs, golf courses, marinas and rental properties; online: hotel and resort reservations and rental bookings via company websites; agents / brokers: third-party and in-house real estate brokers selling homes and land
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; online; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: land use, zoning, environmental and wetlands permitting, local and state development approvals, hospitality food and alcohol licensing
